integrity: The reported verification is symbolic, reproducible and self-reviewed; no external independent validation or authorship is claimed.
limitations: The proof does not cover arbitrary-rate cycle thresholds, positivity of internal RK stages, or an absolute numerical novelty guarantee; independent audit is absent.
scientific_scope: Exact two-stage Radau IIA endpoint positivity on unit-rate directed finite cycles, including an exact six-state threshold, all-step \(n\le5\) classification, and a local \(n\le5\) CTMC extension.
title: Sharp six-state recovery of Markov positivity for Radau IIA on directed cycles
